source_claims.claim: Offsets are jointly fitted from mean observed-minus-synthetic tertiary-star magnitude differences. The source uses weighted scatter/N plus floors, zero-centred priors and emcee-derived covariance. This establishes the estimation procedure, not a measured normalized native density.
source_claims.boundary: Do not assign p=exp(−chi2/2), a coordinate measure or independent Gaussian noises without separately specifying the model/normalization and checking the implementation.

locators: PDFp12 Sec4.3 andp18 AppendixA selected prose/caption
source_claims.claim: The source generates nine calibration realizations from fitted zeropoint covariance, while effective mean-wavelength variations are uncorrelated. Zeropoint realizations are propagated through SALT2 retraining and light-curve fitting. Mean-wavelength variations enter retraining and affect subsequent fitting through the resulting SALT2 surfaces, then contribute to distance-covariance propagation. The wavelength-variation caption specifies Gaussian1sigma uncertainties as chosen variation inputs.
source_claims.boundary: No measured multivariate wavelength law, complete joint probability distribution, actual generator/seed/index identity or cross-probe covariance accepted. Table7 numerical rows are not audited. No separate direct wavelength-shift implementation in the fitting passbands is certified.

source_claims.claim: The authors explain that adding filter shifts to the simultaneous fit would double degrees of freedom and introduce likelihood nonlinearity. Filter-curve uncertainties are instead varied in training systematics without correlations with zeropoints; focal-plane variations are also omitted.
source_claims.boundary: A source modelling omission is not a measurement of zero physical covariance or a qualification of omitted effects. The cited Currie/Betoule primary analyses are unread.
